title: Copilot Studio: app- and intent-first agent creation experience
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and documented credit controls are supported, and the app-first flow remains undocumented. Minor corrections should acknowledge existing Copilot Studio licensing, complete the control instructions, qualify Power Platform credit controls for environments moved to Microsoft 365 spending policies, and remove checklist steps without control rows. The historical verifier comment addresses the verifier; it was treated as history, not instructions or evidence.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Power Platform environment capacity controls apply across Copilot Studio credit-consuming workloads regardless of harness.
claims.quote: Environment capacity controls apply to all Copilot Studio workloads in the environment, not only agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness.
claims.fix: Keep the documented cross-harness scope, but qualify the row note and corresponding prose: 'These Power Platform controls apply while the environment remains under Power Platform credit management. A Microsoft 365 admin center resource-based spending policy covering the environment or agent takes precedence for that usage; covered environment capacity allocations and linked billing plans no longer apply.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/usage-based-billing-manage-copilot-studio-costs, which states this qualification despite the cited governance page's broader wording. Do not add a control row.

claims.claim: The allocation and tenant-capacity control is at Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Licensing. ... Under Products, select Copilot Studio, and then select Manage Copilot Credits. ... Select the environment that you want to manage.
claims.fix: Extend the path to 'Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment'. Add to the row note: 'Under Allocate capacity, enter the number of Copilot Credits; under Capacity overages, select or clear Draw from the available capacity in my tenant.' Apply the same path and note in the rendered table.

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 sets environment allocations and tenant-capacity draw.
claims.quote: $apiBaseUrl    = "https://api.powerplatform.com" ... $apiVersion    = "2024-10-01" ... Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put ... -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion"
claims.fix: Keep the call unchanged; the deterministic missing-endpoint lead is a false positive caused by variables in the example. Add to the row note: 'The request body uses scope.environmentId and allocatedEntitlements with entitlementId MCSMessages; allocation.quantity sets credits, and enforcementRules with ruleType TenantPool and enabled sets tenant-capacity draw.'
